answer: Locks are written down in ferrous, expire in karst, and willow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 108 aliases therefore needs 81 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 68 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
